title: A Nearly Normal Family
overview: The world of a seemingly perfect family shatters when a shocking murder proves that they're willing to make desperate moves to protect one another.

title: Always a Witch
overview: A young 17th-century witch time travels to the future to save the man she loves, but first must adjust to present-day Cartagena and defeat a dark rival.

title: Amidst a Snowstorm of Love
overview: As a professional billiards player, Yin Guo has become quite a notable athlete. After receiving an invitation to play in a tournament in Hel, Yin Guo eagerly accepts. Little does she know that meeting former professional billiards player, Lin Yiyang, in Hel will change her life forever.

title: Back to 15
overview: Unhappy at work and in her personal life, Anita discovers a way to travel back to age 15. What will she change in her past?

title: Caught
overview: Known for catching criminals, famed reporter Ema Garay faces a dilemma when the suspect in a teen's disappearance turns out to be someone close to her.

title: Chasing Love
overview:
Song, a hot nerd and food researcher, arranged a one-night stand with a mysterious woman under a strict condition: no strings attached. However, the other party broke the terms, asking for an emotional connection. Song ended the steamy encounter and walked away.

But the world really is round. That woman turned out to be Piangrawin—the daughter of the president of the company where Song worked. And Piangrawin wasn’t letting go easily. She pursued her with puppy-like devotion, entangling Song's heart and routine with reckless charm. She even claimed she’d already named their future child.

title: Clark
overview: This is the incredible story behind Sweden's most notorious gangster, Clark Olofsson, whose infamous crimes gave rise to the term "Stockholm Syndrome".

title: Cocaine Air: Smugglers at 30,000 Ft.
overview: 2013: four Frenchmen are arrested in Punta Cana with 700 kg of cocaine — none fit the trafficker profile. This documentary asks: who was behind the bust?

title: Detective Hole
overview: When a series of ritualistic murders hits Oslo, a gifted detective must navigate a puzzle of patterns, corruption and his own demons to catch the killer.

title: Doctor John
overview: Cha Yo-Han—an arrogant but genius doctor of anesthesiology—and Kang Shi-Young—a smart, warm resident of anesthesiology—work together to help people with mysterious cases of acute or chronic pain.

title: Falling Into Your Smile
overview: After joining an all-male e-sports team, an amateur gamer tests her skills and leads her team to the world championships.

title: Hometown Romance
overview: Si, a high-society heiress, dreams of becoming the president of her family’s company. However, her parents give the position to her younger sister instead, believing Si is too spoiled and irresponsible, spending millions without a second thought. When the family business faces a crisis involving a crucial land lease renewal, negotiations fail—until Klaokavee, the landowner, makes an unusual proposal: she will renew the lease only if Si agrees to marry her. Despite their completely opposite lifestyles, this strange arrangement brings the two into an unexpected and complicated relationship.

title: I'm Not Afraid
overview: 10-year-old Miguel stumbles upon a terrifying secret involving a boy trapped in a hole near his home.

title: IC 814: The Kandahar Hijack
overview: When IC 814 gets hijacked on its way to Delhi, hundreds of lives are at stake as the country faces its longest and most alarming aviation crisis.

title: Love Between Fairy and Devil
overview: When a low-ranked fairy accidentally resurrects a powerful demon, their fates become cosmically entangled as the world is thrown into turmoil.

title: Luis Miguel: The Series
overview: The series dramatizes the life story of Mexican superstar singer Luis Miguel, who has captivated audiences in Latin America and beyond for decades.

title: Mandala Murders
overview: When a series of ritualistic murders shakes a small town, a detective and an ex-cop must investigate a mystery with deep ties to their pasts.

title: Midnight at the Pera Palace
overview: At a historic Istanbul hotel, a journalist is unexpectedly thrust into the past and must stop a plot that could change the fate of modern Turkey.

title: Mismatched
overview: After a disastrous set-up by their families, two teens strike up a tentative friendship at their summer program - but deeper feelings aren't far behind.

title: My Sad Dead
overview: Emma can see the dead. But when her niece arrives, thousands of lives are shaken.

title: Raising Voices
overview: When a 17-year-old reports a sexual assault at her high school, an investigation upends her life and tests her relationships.

title: Sacred Games
overview: A link in their pasts leads an honest cop to a fugitive gang boss, whose cryptic warning spurs the officer on a quest to save Mumbai from cataclysm.

title: Sandokan
overview: Sandokan is a Malaysian pirate who, along with his friend Yanez and their crew, attacks the British forces from his island of Mompracem. During his adventures, he falls in love with Lady Marianna Guillonk, an English-Italian aristocrat.

title: Snabba Cash
overview: The lives of an ambitious businesswoman, a charming gang enforcer and a troubled teen collide amidst a desperate — and sinister — pursuit of wealth.

title: The Beauty Queen of Jerusalem
overview: The loves, heartbreak, jealousy and pain of the three Armoza sisters – Luna, Rachelika, and Becky - their parents, grandparents and children, set during the early-mid 20th century in Jerusalem.

title: The Cook of Castamar
overview: Set in early 18th-century Madrid, the plot follows the love story between an agoraphobic cook and a widowed nobleman.

title: The Dead Girls
overview: The story of the Baladro sisters, known as “Las Poquianchis”, who built a brothel empire and became merciless killers in 1960s Mexico.

title: The Doll
overview: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

title: The Gift
overview: A painter in Istanbul embarks on a personal journey as she unearths universal secrets about an Anatolian archaeological site and its link to her past.

title: The Map of Longing
overview: Before her death, Lucy creates a game for her sister, Greta, pushing her into a journey of self-discovery — and toward the charming Will Tucker.

title: Museum of Innocence
overview: In 1970s Istanbul, a man's forbidden love for a shop-girl evolves into a lifelong journey of obsession and longing.

title: The Playlist
overview: How Swedish tech entrepreneur Daniel Ek and business partner Martin Lorentzon revolutionized the music industry through free and legal music streaming when they launched Spotify.

title: The Princess Weiyoung
overview: A princess descended from a ruined noble family disguises herself as the woman who saved her life and embarks on a mission to avenge her loved ones.

title: The Spy
overview: In the 1960s, Israeli clerk-turned-secret agent Eli Cohen goes deep undercover inside Syria on a perilous, years-long mission to spy for Mossad.

title: The Untamed
overview: In a magical world of inter-clan rivalry, two soulmates face treacherous schemes and uncover a dark mystery linked to a tragic event in the past.

title: Unorthodox
overview: A Hasidic Jewish woman in Brooklyn flees to Berlin from an arranged marriage and is taken in by a group of musicians — until her past comes calling.

title: Valeria
overview: A writer in a creative and marital crisis finds refuge and support in her three best friends. Based on the novels by Elisabet Benavent.

title: When I Fly Towards You
overview: Set off by a sweet chance encounter, 16-year-old Su Zaizai finds herself helplessly drawn to Zhang Lurang — her smart, charming yet distant schoolmate.

title: Who Rules The World
overview: A legendary wuxia romance that focuses on the decade-long romance between Hei Fengxi and Bai Fengxi, and the adventures they embark on together.
